text.hi: किताब: अकबर-बीरबल की 2-3 कहानियाँ इकट्ठा करो और कक्षा में पढ़ो। बीरबल अकबर के दरबार में थे, तेनाली रामन कृष्णदेवराय के।
text.hinglish: Kitaab: Akbar-Birbal ki 2-3 kahaniyaan ikattha karo aur kaksha mein padho. Birbal Akbar ke darbaar mein the, Tenali Raman Krishnadevaraya ke.
text.en: The book: collect 2 or 3 Akbar-Birbal stories and read them in class. Birbal was in Akbar's court; Tenali Raman was in Krishnadevaraya's.

steps.question: King Krishnadevaraya ruled which great empire?

questionMeaning.hi: कृष्णदेवराय किस साम्राज्य के राजा थे?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Krishnadevaraya kis saamraajya ke raja the?

steps.question: The title ‘Measure for Measure’ means ...
options: a mistake answered with a similar example
steps.answer: a mistake answered with a similar example
steps.modelAnswer: Measure for measure: Tenali Raman answered the king's mistake (an artist as chief minister) with a similar one (a carpenter as cook).

modelMeaning.hi: जैसे को तैसा: राजा की गलती (चित्रकार को मुख्यमंत्री) का जवाब वैसी ही मिसाल (बढ़ई को रसोइया) से।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Jaise ko taisa: raja ki galti (chitrakaar ko mukhyamantri) ka jawab waisi hi misaal (badhai ko rasoiya) se.

steps.question: What is the lesson of this story?
options: Give each job to the person trained for it.
steps.answer: Give each job to the person trained for it.
